items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: Yeah, Kutcher Martin with him. Henry Martin.

ctx.x: Paul Crawford. And Dick Allen. Four of us, yeah. He wanted to talk about Bab Frank. Ask him about Bab.

So he wanted to talk about Bab Frank. I'll tell you a message I know about him. I was young then, you know. He had Bab Frank. He had a good band in his days, you know. He had a 70th band. He used to play all for these lawn parties, they called him at that time, yeah. And, uh, he was good at that time. He played a piccolo. Yeah, Kutcher Martin with him. Henry Martin. And I just remember who else he had, you know. But yeah, he was strong. He and John Robeshoe were the strongest one at that time, you know. For…
Was it a ragtime band or a reading band?

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I believe he had, uh, uh, Martin on drums. Henry Martin? Henry Martin, yeah.

ctx.x: So, ask him? Ask him who was with Ori.

Who was with Ori? Chip Matthews, Stonewall, Johnny Brown, and Johnny Dot. He's there too, yeah. He had. Let me see. He had, let me see. Ask him the instruments too. He was playing drummers. I said, what instrument did they play? What instrument did they play? Well, uh, Chip Matthews played a trumpet. Johnny Dot, Clioness, Kid Ori on the trombone, Eddie Gardner on the bass. And, uh, let me see. Stonewall, you see. Stonewall? Stonewall was on the guitar. And, uh, I believe he had, uh, uh, Martin on drums. Henry…
